description: For each LandLot on the map, randomly places a house at a random spot inside the lot and clears the Forest/Grass under it. Run AFTER MapSkeletonGenerator (which creates the lots). The class is LandLotContentGenerator; pass either name to --name.

houseProbability.description: Chance (0..1) that a given land lot gets a house.

forestProbability.description: Currently NOT read by this generator (kept for compatibility). Use ForestGenerator to add trees.

houseModels.description: Comma-separated house model names to pick from at random, e.g. house1,house2. Each must be a valid object type (see list-objects).
